local_checks.invariant: Host persistence shim must not expose or accept salon:* storage across different viewers, and restored keys must not reach an executing sink
local_checks.result: The shim mirrors only salon:-prefixed keys to db.collection('data/users/' + await user.id()) and restores from the same collection; per the db capability contract data/users/<id>/ is private to that viewer, so writes and reads are scoped to the same principal and nothing crosses viewers. No cross-principal path.
